thread:
Evelyn (CSM): Aurum private VPC onboarding 9am sync recap: outstanding = NAT IPs, CMK alias+policy, CloudTrail retention, and Splunk cert. Fast updates please.

Marcus (Network): They gave subnets 10.210.0.0/16 but no NAT pool. Can't apply firewall until we get egress IPs. Recommend 443 -> proxy, 22 -> bastion from their office CIDR.

Sofia (SRE): CMK: alias is alias/aurum-main, key-id 9f8e7d6c. Our automation expects alias/redwood-customer-aurum. We can deploy with key-id for now.

Ritik (Security): CloudTrail retention currently 45d. This is below our 365d baseline and flagged for renewal risk. Evelyn please send cost delta and ask for signoff or Glacier archiving.

Evelyn (CSM): Will send cost delta this afternoon and propose Glacier+Lifecycle as a compromise. Also asked them to add our role ARN to the CMK policy; they said they'll update tonight.

Marcus (Network): Sample firewall snippet I pasted in ticket CS-14021: allow tcp 443 from 10.210.0.0/16 to 10.11.2.10; allow tcp 22 from 203.0.113.0/24 to 10.11.2.20 (bastion).

cert-bot: Need collector fqdn+owner email to issue cert. Will produce PEM, TTL 90d.

Sofia (SRE): Runbook note: if alias mismatch, use key-id fallback and open follow-up ticket CS-14022 for alias rename before rotation.

Evelyn (CSM): Action items: I	send retention cost delta (EOD), Marcus apply firewall on NAT IP receipt, Sofia deploy with key-id fallback and open CS-14022, cert-bot await fqdn/email. Mid-week check-in scheduled. :thumbsup:
